environment.description: Flask application packaged as container image and deployed via AWS Lambda with function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda execution role has a resource-based policy that grants lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl only to principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/CICDPipelineRole with condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4. Unauthenticated requests (missing or invalid SigV4 signature) receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service invoke endpoint before reaching application code. The Lambda runtime uses a read-only filesystem except /tmp (512MB, ephemeral, isolated per invocation). No VPC attachment; runs in Lambda's managed network environment.

config.runtime: AWS Lambda container image (read-only root fs, /tmp ephemeral 512MB)
config.resource_policy: lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl granted only to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/CICDPipelineRole with StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID = o-abc123def4
config.network: No public ALB, function URL is the only ingress point
config.filesystem: read-only root, /tmp is per-invocation ephemeral sandbox
